# tenure determinacy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureDeterminacy`](gmeow-tenureDeterminacy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureDeterminacy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ontic determinacy model of this land tenure's boundary or claim — crisp (surveyed), vague (approximate), fuzzy (probabilistic), or disputed. Non-functional: sources may disagree on determinacy, and those claims coexist.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md)

Use [`gmeow:tenureDeterminacy`](gmeow-tenureDeterminacy.md) from [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md), [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md), [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the ontic determinacy of a tenure's boundary or claim — crisp, vague, fuzzy, or disputed; a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md), non-functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with confidence; this records the claim's nature.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:tenureDeterminacy`](gmeow-tenureDeterminacy.md) to a [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) individual; sources may disagree and those claims coexist.
